command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

samtools sort -o sample.bam aln.sam 2> sort.log
samtools index sample.bam
samtools faidx ref.fa
samtools view -c sample.bam | awk '{print "bam_records", $1}'

echo "== the deletion located from COVERAGE alone -- no SV caller involved =="
samtools depth -a -J sample.bam > depth.txt
awk '$3==0{ if(!i){st=$2; i=1}; en=$2 }
     $3>0 { if(i){ L=en-st+1; if(L>bL){bL=L;bS=st;bE=en}; i=0 } }
     END  { if(i){ L=en-st+1; if(L>bL){bL=L;bS=st;bE=en} }
            printf "%d\t%d\t%d\n", bS, bE, bL }' depth.txt > depth_interval.txt
read -r DS DE DL < depth_interval.txt
NRUNS=$(awk '$3==0{if(!i){n++;i=1}} $3>0{i=0} END{print n+0}' depth.txt)

TS=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_start"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
TE=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_end"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)
TL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_len"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)

# EXACT: across 20 kb there is one and only one gap, and it lies inside the planted deletion
test "$NRUNS" = "1"       || { echo "expected exactly 1 zero-coverage run, found $NRUNS"; exit 1; }
test "$DS" -ge "$TS"      || { echo "gap starts before the planted deletion ($DS < $TS)"; exit 1; }
test "$DE" -le "$TE"      || { echo "gap ends after the planted deletion ($DE > $TE)"; exit 1; }
# SOFT, with a mechanism: alignments extend a few bp into the deletion where the flanks
# share micro-homology, so coverage cannot resolve the breakpoint to the base.
PCT=$(awk -v d="$DL" -v t="$TL" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*d/t}')
awk -v d="$DL" -v t="$TL" 'BEGIN{ if (d < 0.98*t) { printf "coverage gap recovered only %d of %d bp\n", d, t; exit 1 } }'

{
printf 'Deletion located from COVERAGE alone (an independent signal from any SV caller)\n'
printf 'zero_cov_runs\t%s   (assert 1 -- EXACT: one gap in 20 kb, no spurious gaps)\n' "$NRUNS"
printf 'zero_cov_interval\t%s-%s (%s bp)\n' "$DS" "$DE" "$DL"
printf 'planted_deletion\t%s-%s (%s bp)\n' "$TS" "$TE" "$TL"
printf 'contained_in_planted\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT containment)\n'
printf 'bases_recovered\t%s of %s (%s%%)   (assert >=98%% -- NOT exact by construction, see note)\n' "$DL" "$TL" "$PCT"
printf 'note\tcoverage cannot resolve the breakpoint to the base: where the flanks share a few bp of\n'
printf 'note\tmicro-homology with the deletion edges, bwa extends alignments into the deleted interval.\n'
printf 'note\tThat is why the cross-check below is CONTAINMENT, not equality.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-depth.txt
echo "DEPTH CHECK PASSED"
